verdict.label: Will not load correctly
verdict.detail: 1 blocker must be fixed before this mod can be expected to work.

findings.title: coui:// directory "AutoFactory" does not match identifier "com.pa.kasa.hcom-server"
findings.detail: ui/mods/AutoFactory is absent here but supplied by a build-time overlay or the paired mod, so it resolves in the packaged form.
findings.why: The identifier, the ui/mods/<dir> folder name and the directory inside every coui:// URL are conventionally the same. Where they disagree and the folder is absent, the game loads nothing and reports nothing.

findings.title: 2 emitters use `snapToSurface`, which is expensive
findings.why: The guide marks this "THIS IS EXPENSIVE, USE ONLY WHEN NEEDED!" ÔÇö every spawning particle traces a line towards the planet centre against the ground mesh. It is intended for very large effects only.
findings.fix: Confirm the effect is large enough to justify the cost; for smaller effects use a fixed offset instead.
